data.long_meaning: Derived from the Greek word 'katharos', meaning 'purified' or 'clean'. In Christianity, it can represent spiritual purity and holiness. The name Kettie carries the meaning “Pure, Holy” and is chosen by families in Christian traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Biblical tradition and is also used in English, Greek, Latin. Parents who choose Kettie usually hope their child will grow to embody pure, holy and live with faith, good character and purpose.
